added_sources: Hold {key} and scroll the mouse wheel to zoom. Drag empty space to move around. Fit shows the whole map.
Solid arrows: documented handoffs. Dashed arrows: matching data types, requiring compatibility checks.
semantic_review: Three flowchart controls preserve zoom/pan/fit and distinguish documented arrows from compatibility-dependent data types in all nine languages. Korean 빈 공간 means empty space here; other source contexts remain protected.
documentation_delta: Host–Pathogen Analysis now appears under Toxoplasma with its dedicated API page; five assays.
installation_delta: English quick-start repeats the PyPI desktop command; the full PyPI and conda-forge routes remain separate.
retired_readme_sources: spaCR in slides: every module and the trained models, in 51 slides

A tour of every module and the trained models in 51 slides. Flip through them in the `slide viewer <https://einarolafsson.github.io/spacr/_static/deck/>`_ (arrow keys or swipe), or page through the `PDF on GitHub <docs/source/_static/deck/spacr_deck.pdf>`_.
See the `installer guide <docs/source/installer_guide.rst>`_ for update, uninstall, offline and troubleshooting instructions.

The `interactive spaCR tutorial library <https://einarolafsson.github.io/spacr/tutorials/>`_ contains narrated, captioned walkthroughs of installation and of each application workflow, in 73 lessons with 50 voices across eight languages.

readme_tutorial_availability.source: The `interactive spaCR tutorial library <https://einarolafsson.github.io/spacr/tutorials/>`_ provides installation and module walkthroughs. Available narration and languages are listed for each lesson.
